uncited: - Point clouds $\chi_1$ and $\chi_2$ are stored as arrays of coordinates.
- The first term averages the distance from each point in $\chi_1$ to its nearest neighbor in $\chi_2$.
- The second term averages the distance from each point in $\chi_2$ to its nearest neighbor in $\chi_1$.
For each point $x \in \chi_1$, find the nearest neighbor $y \in \chi_2$.
Compute the Euclidean distance $||x - y||_2$ for all $x \in \chi_1$ and average them to get the first term.
For each point $y \in \chi_2$, find the nearest neighbor $x \in \chi_1$.
Compute the Euclidean distance $||y - x||_2$ for all $y \in \chi_2$ and average them to get the second term.
Sum the two averaged terms to obtain the final CD value.
